description: You can read a let with two independent values and a shared body.
source: draft: codex free model + edit: codex

steps.description: The first binding pair gives a the value 3. You are inside the list of bindings for this let.
The second pair gives b the value 4 and closes the binding list. Both names are available in the body.

steps.answer: It adds the two squares, producing 25.
steps.question: What does the body compute from a equal to 3 and b equal to 4?

steps.description: You see 25 in the output. Each multiplication uses a local binding supplied by this let.

title: Using two local bindings
